before.metaTitle: Geely Coolray Battle Edition | Export from China
before.metaDescription: Geely Coolray Battle Edition specs: 1.5T, 7DCT, 133 kW and 290 Nm China-market reference. Compare trim details and request current export stock and FOB pricing.
before.heroDescription: Compare the Geely Coolray Battle Edition for export from China using the 2025 Binyue L 1.5TD DCT Battle as the China-market reference: a 1.5T four-cylinder petrol engine, 7-speed wet dual-clutch transmission and five-seat SUV body. Check the specifications below, then confirm the exact export vehicle, equipment, colors and quotation before ordering.
before.overviewText: The reference model is the 2025 China-market Binyue L 1.5TD DCT Battle listed by Autohome at the same RMB 97,800 guide price as our Battle listing. This reference does not certify the configuration of a particular export unit. Match the VIN and equipment list before confirming an order; do not substitute the 1.5L CVT Super Power or another Coolray trim.

specificationSource.name: Autohome
specificationSource.scope: China-market reference matched by Battle name and RMB 97,800 guide price; export unit requires VIN confirmation

before.contactHeading: Request Geely Coolray Battle Edition Quote
before.contactText: Send your destination country, target quantity and preferred Coolray trim. We will confirm current availability, configuration, FOB quote and shipping options from China.

detailSections.title: Specification Source and Export-Unit Checks
paragraphs: Reference specifications were checked against Autohome model 75683 on 2 September 2026. They describe the China-market reference model, not a guarantee for every vehicle offered for export. Real fuel use varies with load, road conditions and driving style.

Before order, request the VIN or exact vehicle reference, production date, engine and gearbox identification, equipment list and current photos. Confirm sunroof, tailgate package, infotainment language and destination-market requirements separately. China-market warranty terms are not an overseas warranty commitment.
